about_the_game:
Descend deeper into the madness with Worshippers of Cthulhu: Event Pack. This expansion introduces 41 brand-new narrative events, each inspired by the twisted pantheon of the Cthulhu Mythos. Confront the influence of Hastur, Nyarlathotep, Shub-Niggurath, Yog-Sothoth, and many more as their whispers seep into your cult and reshape the destiny of your followers.

Every event offers chilling illustrations and unsettling choices that test your devotion, sanity, and ambition. Will you embrace the gifts of the Great Old Ones, or resist their grasp at the cost of everything you’ve built?

Integrated seamlessly into all existing maps, these events ensure that no two playthroughs are ever the same. Whether in sandbox mode or campaign, the presence of the Old Ones is inescapable - guiding, tempting, or punishing with every decision.

Key Features:

  • 41 original narrative events steeped in cosmic horror and player choice

  • New illustrations capturing the eerie atmosphere of each encounter

  • Influence of the Mythos gods woven into gameplay, including Hastur, Nyarlathotep, Dagon, Shub-Niggurath, Yog-Sothoth, and more

  • Events integrated across all maps, adding replayability and unpredictability

Step into the unknown, embrace the whispers, and lead your cult beneath the watchful gaze of powers beyond comprehension.
